item.description:
• Kit stays in the Claude app. If Kit had been removed from Claude's settings, it puts itself back, and Connected tools now tells you plainly when something is missing instead of showing a tick.
  • While Kit is updating or dreaming, clicking its Dock icon or menu brings you back to that screen instead of opening Kit halfway through, and quitting mid-update asks first.
  • Kit no longer switches off a tool that is still working, and never deletes Claude's own settings file.
